market_summary.trend: BTC ~$64,900 (-1.9% in 24h). ETH -2.5% to $1,882. BTC failed to reclaim $70k consolidation zone — structural weakness persists. Weekly bounce +3.8% but broader June decline was -14%.
market_summary.sentiment: Fear & Greed index 26 (Fear zone, near lowest in July). Whale wallets continue distributing while retail accumulates — bearish divergence. Long-term holders accumulating at current levels provides floor support, but spot/futures volumes declining and blockchain activity subdued.
market_summary.macro: No CPI/PPI releases July 25 (June CPI already released July 14: -0.4% MoM, +3.5% YoY — softer than expected). FOMC July 28-29, rate decision July 29 14:00 ET; current rate 3.5-3.75%. Market watching for hold vs cut signal. Japan reclassified crypto as 'financial assets' with reduced taxes — long-term bullish for Asian demand.
market_summary.etf_flows: ETF inflows paused; market digesting after earlier outflow streak in June (worst ETF month on record: ~$4B redemptions). Goldman Sachs filed new BTC ETF registration in April 2026 — regulatory pipeline growing but no near-term SEC decisions expected.
market_summary.resistance_support: Resistance: $66,000-$66,500. Support: $64,500. Below $64,500 targets $63,000-$63,500 ahead of FOMC. No strong recovery catalyst in next 24h.
market_summary.regulatory: CLARITY Act still stalled in Senate. No BTC ETF SEC decisions expected next 24h. Japan crypto tax reform positive long-term. FOMC July 29 is key macro risk event — current rate 3.5-3.75%, market pricing hold.
